transcript.statement: The system must uphold ethical and compliance standards through robust regulations and accountability measures. RES-01 ensures compliance with financial regulations, critical for legal adherence. RES-02 guarantees that only authorized users can modify transactions, preventing fraud. RES-03 maintains transparency via audit trails. RES-04 proactively detects discrepancies, fostering user trust. RES-05 supports fair financial reporting, pivotal for ethical practices. RES-06 allows confidential reporting of ethical concerns, enhancing accountability. RES-07 provides multi-currency support, ensuring fairness in transactions across regions.

transcript.statement: The Trustworthiness requirements are essential for ensuring data protection, user access control, and maintaining the integrity of financial transactions. TRU-01 ensures that all financial data is encrypted, protecting it from unauthorized access during transmission and storage. TRU-02 establishes role-based access control, crucial for limiting user permissions effectively. TRU-03 maintains an immutable audit trail, vital for accountability and transparency in transactions. TRU-04 validates data input to prevent malicious entries, enhancing security. TRU-05 implements two-factor authentication, ensuring only authorized users access sensitive data. TRU-06 logs user access for accountability, and TRU-07 restricts data access to relevant accounts, further safeguarding user privacy. These requirements collectively uphold the security and integrity of the system.

transcript.statement: The Safety and Reliability requirements are critical for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of financial data. SAF-01 ensures accurate recording of transactions to prevent data loss or corruption, while SAF-02 enforces double-entry bookkeeping principles to maintain data integrity. SAF-03 guarantees the retention of audit trails for accountability. SAF-04's error handling mechanisms are essential for managing faults, and SAF-05 supports safe degradation during outages, ensuring essential functionalities remain accessible. SAF-06 validates currency conversions, preventing financial discrepancies, and SAF-07 mandates regular backups to protect against data loss. Together, these requirements create a robust safety framework.

transcript.statement: The Sustainability requirements are essential for minimizing environmental impact. GRN-01 targets energy efficiency during data processing, crucial for reducing operational costs and carbon emissions. GRN-02 promotes cloud-based solutions, which can significantly lower the carbon footprint compared to traditional servers. GRN-03 supports document digitization to minimize paper usage, aligning with eco-friendly practices. GRN-04 tracks the lifecycle resource impact, identifying areas for improvement. GRN-05 provides sustainability reports to raise awareness of energy consumption. GRN-06 enables carbon offsetting for transactions, and GRN-07 ensures compliance with sustainability regulations. Together, these requirements foster an environmentally responsible bookkeeping system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall implement a comprehensive user access control framework to restrict modifications to authorized personnel.
The system shall maintain a unified audit trail of all transactions to ensure accountability and transparency.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring that users can access essential functionalities even during outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall ensure rapid processing of financial transactions within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30% compared to traditional methods.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates to ensure fairness in international transactions.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
